faq.question: Is this a stock news API for AAPL, TSLA, and NVDA?
faq.answer: Yes. It filters US market headlines for Apple, Tesla, and Nvidia and returns JSON you can download or call via the Apify API—useful as a lightweight stock news API.

faq.question: Which publishers feed this Apple Tesla Nvidia news task?
faq.answer: MarketWatch, CNBC, Bloomberg, and Yahoo Finance RSS via us_markets, then stories matching those company names (tickers AAPL, TSLA, NVDA when detected).

faq.question: Do I need to change any input before starting?
faq.answer: No. Click Start for the last 24 hours of Apple, Tesla, and Nvidia news (up to 50 JSON items).

faq.question: Can I add tickers or alert only on new articles?
